# Changelog

All notable changes to **SuperClaude for SAP (sc4sap)** will be documented in this file.
Format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/); versioning follows [SemVer](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [1.0.0] — 2026-11-20

First stable release. No breaking change from 0.6.71: skills, agents, profiles and the MCP pin stay as they are.

### Added
- **create-program cost rules** (`skills/create-program/cost-rules.md`): fix rounds by main-thread Edit or a fresh agent (never a resumed one), diff-only re-review that is skipped when only MINOR findings were fixed, a post-delivery `--fix` mode that starts a new session from `handoff.md` (system proved by profile + `SearchObject` before any write), and reference sources read by Haiku scouts instead of the main thread. In eco, executors run on Sonnet · medium with Opus · medium on escalation. Measured basis: one run spent 40% on the main thread (context 87k → 580k), 35% on Opus executors, 18% on Opus reviewers.
- **Interface testing**: `IF.TEST.CALL` fenced interface test call (ABAP handler + catalog, not installed by default), `IF.LOG.CHECK` read-only self-check of the caller's test log rows, and an interface test report (per-case run time, BAPIRETURN codes, refused runs fail, stale runs flagged, phone cards).
- **AI checks against SAP**: `uat-scenarios` scenario check (each step compared with SAP, privacy reason when a read is refused), `role-matrix` "SAP 반영 확인" (document roles compared with SAP), `interface-mapping-spec` DDIC object check.
- Form fidelity scoring harnesses in the repo (`scripts/forms-common/fidelity`).

### Changed
- README in four languages rewritten for first-time readers: what you get by role, five-step start, plain-chat routing, safety, cost modes; animated mascot and a larger site link.
- SmartForm preview r21–r22 (multi-page zoom, browser-less pagination, header repeated on later pages); Adobe preview r24–r25 (XFA 2.1 field layout, wraps after decimal / right / center tabs).
- Korean pages break lines between words; transport check, CAB notes and cutover pages show Korean / Japanese labels; accessibility and touch fixes in spec, config, process and gap pages.
- `config-to-document`: zoom viewer for screen and flow drawings.

### Fixed
- `role-matrix`: T-code texts read only for real T-codes (400 on S/4).
- Dispatcher `TABLE_READ`: customer tables readable under the SE16 check on ECC.
- Every plugin CSV export guards against formula injection.
- Blocklist hook tests no longer read the real user profile.

Turns a sentence about concrete documents ("open POs of vendor 100023", "set a billing block on order 4711") into one business action of the connected system: it asks what is still open one question at a time, shows the lookup as a table, previews a change before → after with SAP's messages, and executes only after your yes for exactly that preview. Needs `SAP_TOOL_PROFILE=biz` or `all` and the SAP-side business handlers; production profiles get lookups only.
### `/sc4sap:smartform-to-adobe`
+> **Beta — output quality is still low.** Check every result in SFP before relying on it.

Before anyone runs SAP's SmartForm migration (it saves at once and has no test mode), the skill works out node by node what the migration makes of the form — interface, context, layout, SAP's predicted messages, and what SAP drops without a message — and writes one HTML report (`adobe-plan-<lang>.html`) with the gap list, silent gaps first, and the manual step for each. For SAP example SmartForms on DEV it can run the migration into new `$TMP` objects; the migrated form is then drawn with `/sc4sap:adobe-preview`.

## [0.6.1] - 2026-04-21

### 추가
- **`/sc4sap:setup` 멀티 프로필 인식** — 위저드에 Step 0 (레거시 감지 + 프로필 부트스트랩)와 전용 프로필 생성 플로우 (`skills/setup/wizard-step-04-profile-creation.md`) 추가. 0.6.0 이전 `<project>/.sc4sap/sap.env` 사용자는 `sap-profile-cli.mjs migrate`로 자동 마이그레이션; 신규 설치는 `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/` 아래 첫 프로필을 OS 키체인 연동 비밀번호 저장으로 생성.
- **Tier 게이트 Step 9** — ABAP 유틸리티 설치 (`ZMCP_ADT_UTILS`, `ZCL_S4SAP_CM_*`, OData/ZRFC 클래스) 는 `SAP_TIER=DEV`에서만 실행. QA/PRD 프로필은 설치 거부 + CTS import 가이드 출력; DEV 설치는 `SAP_URL+SAP_CLIENT` 기준으로 sibling 프로필 간 중복 제거 (`~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/.abap-utils-installed` sentinel).
- **Step 12 PreToolUse 2중 훅** — `.claude/settings.json` (프로젝트 레벨) 에 `block-forbidden-tables.mjs`와 `tier-readonly-guard.mjs` **모두** 설치, 각각 스모크 테스트 수행.
- **공유 프로필 resolver** (`scripts/lib/profile-resolve.mjs`) — `resolveSapEnvPath`, `resolveConfigJsonPath`, `resolveArtifactBase`, `readActiveSapEnv`, `readActiveConfigJson`, `readDotenv`, `normalizeTier`. HUD / 훅 / 스크립트가 사용하는 active-profile → `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/` 해석 패턴 일원화.
- **Gap-plan 문서** (`docs/multi-profile-setup-gap.md`) — `multi-profile-design.md` + `-implementation-plan.md`의 자매 문서; setup 스킬 리트로핏을 위한 5개 결정 기록.

content.content:
183	## 🌐 Multi-Environment Profiles (Dev / QA / Prod)
184	
185	**Multinational SAP customers run a 3-tier landscape per legal entity** (Sandbox / Dev / QA / Prod; often several legal entities: KR, US, DE…). sc4sap supports managing all of them from a single Claude Code session, with **automatic safety rails on non-Dev tiers.**
186	
187	### Profile storage
188	
189	| Where | What |
190	|---|---|
191	| `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/sap.env` | User-level profile definition (connection, tier, industry, modules). Shared across all repos. |
192	| `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/config.json` | User-level per-profile config (naming convention, systemInfo, activeTransport history). |
193	| `~/.sc4sap/profiles/.trash/` | Soft-deleted profiles, auto-purged 7 days after removal. |
194	| `<project>/.sc4sap/active-profile.txt` | Project-level pointer — which profile this repo talks to right now. |
195	| `<project>/.sc4sap/work/<alias>/` | Project artifacts (specs, CBO catalogs, audits) per profile. Read-only cross-view: a QA session can see Dev-produced specs, but writes always land under the active profile. |
196	
197	### Tier-based readonly enforcement (Strict policy)
198	
199	`SAP_TIER` is an enum: `DEV` | `QA` | `PRD`. Non-canonical tiers (Sandbox, Staging, Pre-Prod, Training) map to the safer equivalent (e.g. Staging → PRD).
200	
201	| Tool family | DEV | QA | PRD |
202	|---|---|---|---|
203	| `Create*` / `Update*` / `Delete*` (DDIC, ABAP, CDS, BO, SB, MDE, Screen, GUI, Package) | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
204	| `CreateTransport` | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
205	| `RunUnitTest` | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ |
206	| `RuntimeRunProgramWithProfiling` / `RuntimeRunClassWithProfiling` | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
207	| `Get*` / `Read*` / `Search*` / `RuntimeAnalyze*` / `RuntimeList*` / `ValidateServiceBinding` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
208	
209	Two-layer defense:
210	- **Layer 1 — PreToolUse hook** (`scripts/hooks/tier-readonly-guard.mjs`) installed via `scripts/install-hooks.mjs`. Fires before the tool request is sent; emits a clear deny reason the LLM can explain to the user.
211	- **Layer 2 — MCP server guard** (`abap-mcp-adt-powerup/src/lib/readonlyGuard.ts`) — uncircumventable. Even if the user disables hooks or skips the plugin install, the server rejects mutation tools on QA/PRD with `ERR_READONLY_TIER`. `ReloadProfile` is always allowed so users can switch back to Dev without an escape hatch debate.
212	
213	### OS keychain for passwords (`@napi-rs/keyring`)
214	
215	Profiles store `SAP_PASSWORD=keychain:sc4sap/<alias>/<user>` — a reference, not the secret. The real value lives in the OS credential store:
216	
217	| OS | Backend |
218	|---|---|
219	| Windows | Credential Manager |
220	| macOS | Keychain |
221	| Linux | libsecret (GNOME Keyring / KWallet) |
222	
223	Implementation uses `@napi-rs/keyring` — Rust + N-API prebuilt binaries (no `node-gyp` compilation on install, no rebuild on Node version bumps). Declared as `optionalDependencies`; headless environments (Docker, CI) gracefully fall back to `SAP_PASSWORD_STORAGE=file` (plaintext with a prominent warning). Existing plaintext `.sc4sap/sap.env` files are migrated into the keychain on first upgrade.
224	
225	### Switching, adding, removing profiles
226	
227	All via `/sc4sap:sap-option`:
228	
229	- **Switch** — interactive picker (native `AskUserQuestion` UI) with per-profile preview panel showing connection details + the tools-allowed matrix. Writes `active-profile.txt`, calls `mcp__sap__ReloadProfile` on the MCP server (no Claude Code restart needed), and the HUD re-renders with the new `alias [tier] 🔒` badge.
230	- **Add** — wizard captures alias, tier, host/client/user, password (streamed directly to keychain, never shown on-screen). Same-company auto-detection: adding `KR-QA` while `KR-DEV` exists offers to copy `SAP_INDUSTRY`, `SAP_ACTIVE_MODULES`, `ABAP_RELEASE`, and the `namingConvention` block.
231	- **Remove** — requires the user to type the alias verbatim for confirmation. Archives to `.trash/{alias}-{timestamp}/` instead of hard-deleting. Refuses if the alias is the active profile.
232	- **Edit** — modifies non-tier fields (tier is immutable through this path to prevent accidental PRD → DEV downgrades). Password edits rewrite the keychain entry.
233	- **Purge** — permanently deletes `.trash/*` older than 7 days (or `--all` for immediate full clear).
234	
235	### Migration from legacy single-profile `sap.env`
236	
237	Existing users upgrading to the multi-profile release see a SessionStart banner (`scripts/legacy-migration-banner.mjs`) the first time they start Claude Code in a project with `.sc4sap/sap.env` but no `active-profile.txt`. The banner points them to `/sc4sap:sap-option` which drives a two-question migration wizard (alias, tier). The legacy file is renamed to `sap.env.legacy` for rollback; no data is deleted.
238	
239	### HUD
240	
241	Line 2 of the statusline shows `{alias} [{tier}]` with a 🔒 when `tier != DEV`. Color is not used — the lock icon is the single, theme-independent signal.
242	
243	```
244	 KR-DEV [DEV]       SID S4H · client 100 · user DEVELOPER · CTS DEVK904224
245	 KR-PRD [PRD] 🔒    SID S4P · client 400 · user READER
246	```

251	- Implementation plan: [`multi-profile-implementation-plan.md`](multi-profile-implementation-plan.md)
252	- CLI: `scripts/sap-profile-cli.mjs` (list / switch / add / remove / migrate / purge / keychain-set / keychain-delete)

276

304	## Context Loading Architecture (v0.5.2+)
305	
306	sc4sap's rule corpus is large — 25+ `common/*.md` + 14 `configs/{MODULE}/*.md` + 30+ industry/country files. Loading every file on every agent dispatch wastes tokens and dilutes model attention. The **4-tier context loading model** (defined in [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](../common/context-loading-protocol.md)) separates "always-load safety rails" from "role-specific baseline" from "condition-triggered" from "per-task kit".
307	
308	| Tier | When loaded | Files |
309	|------|-------------|-------|
310	| **Tier 1 — Global Mandatory** | Every agent, every skill, every session start | `data-extraction-policy.md`, `sap-version-reference.md`, `naming-conventions.md` |
311	| **Tier 2 — Role-Mandatory** | Agent's role group fixed set, session start | varies by role group (see below) |
312	| **Tier 3 — Triggered Reads** | When a condition matches the current task | ALV → `alv-rules.md` · Procedural → `clean-code-procedural.md` + `ok-code-pattern.md` · `CALL SCREEN` → `ok-code-pattern.md` · ECC → `ecc-ddic-fallback.md` · industry/country set → corresponding file · etc. |
313	| **Tier 4 — Per-Task Kit** | Declared by the dispatching skill/phase/bucket | per wave in `phase4-parallel.md`, per §1-§12 in `phase6-review.md` |
314	
315	### Tier 2 role groups
316	
317	| Role group | Agents | Tier 2 adds |
318	|------------|--------|-------------|
319	| **Code Writer** | `sap-executor`, `sap-qa-tester`, `sap-debugger` | `clean-code.md`, `abap-release-reference.md`, `transport-client-rule.md`, `include-structure.md` (+ paradigm file) |
320	| **Reviewer** | `sap-code-reviewer`, `sap-critic` | `clean-code.md`, `abap-release-reference.md`, `include-structure.md` (per-bucket narrowing in Phase 6) |
321	| **Planner / Architect** | `sap-planner`, `sap-architect` | `include-structure.md`, `active-modules.md`, `customization-lookup.md`, `field-typing-rule.md` |
322	| **Analyst / Writer** | `sap-analyst`, `sap-writer` | `active-modules.md` |
323	| **Doc Specialist** | `sap-doc-specialist` | *(none — task-driven only)* |
324	| **Module Consultant** | 14 module consultants (SD, MM, FI, CO, PP, PS, PM, QM, TR, HCM, WM, TM, BW, Ariba) | `spro-lookup.md`, `customization-lookup.md`, `active-modules.md`, `configs/{MODULE}/*.md` (on demand — only the file the question needs) |
325	| **Basis Consultant** | `sap-bc-consultant` | `transport-client-rule.md`, `configs/common/*.md` |
326	
327	### Enforcement
328	
329	Every `agents/*.md` file declares its role group in a `<Mandatory_Baseline>` block at the top of `<Agent_Prompt>`. The agent loads Tier 1 + Tier 2 at session start before any MCP call. Skill prompts declare only Tier 4 (per-task) additions; Tier 1+2 are assumed. On a MAJOR blocker the agent returns `BLOCKED — context kit insufficient: <list>` so the skill can provide an updated kit.
330	
331	### Measured effects
332	
333	- Per-dispatch tokens: −40 to −60% vs pre-v0.5.0 implicit load-all pattern.
334	- Opus usage share in `/sc4sap:create-program`: −50% (routing matrix in `model-routing-rule.md`).
335	- Reviewer MAJOR-finding detection: improved — each of §1-§12 runs with only its relevant rule in context instead of skimming 12 rule files at once.
336	
337	## Response Prefix Convention (v0.5.2+)
338	
339	Every `/sc4sap:*` skill-triggered response begins with a one-line prefix so the user can see at a glance which model is running the work and which sub-agents were dispatched:
340	
341	```
342	[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]
343	```
344	
345	Examples:
346	
347	```
348	[Model: Opus]
349	— pure main-thread response, no sub-agent dispatches
350	
351	[Model: Opus · Dispatched: Sonnet×2]
352	— main thread + two parallel Sonnet executors (Wave 2 G4-prep text bulk)
353	
354	[Model: Opus · Dispatched: Opus×1 (planner)]
355	— Phase 2 planner dispatch
356	
357	[Model: Opus · Dispatched: Sonnet×3 (B3a executor range α/β/γ)]
358	— Multi-Executor Split per multi-executor-split.md Strategy A
359	```
360

The prefix applies only to skill-triggered turns and unrelated-pivot user messages drop the prefix on the turn they arrive.

## 🌐 Multi-Environment Profiles (Dev / QA / Prod)

**Multinational SAP customers run a 3-tier landscape per legal entity** (Sandbox / Dev / QA / Prod; often several legal entities: KR, US, DE…). sc4sap supports managing all of them from a single Claude Code session, with **automatic safety rails on non-Dev tiers.**

### Profile storage

| Where | What |
|---|---|
| `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/sap.env` | User-level profile definition (connection, tier, industry, modules). Shared across all repos. |
| `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/config.json` | User-level per-profile config (naming convention, systemInfo, activeTransport history). |
| `~/.sc4sap/profiles/.trash/` | Soft-deleted profiles, auto-purged 7 days after removal. |
| `<project>/.sc4sap/active-profile.txt` | Project-level pointer — which profile this repo talks to right now. |
| `<project>/.sc4sap/work/<alias>/` | Project artifacts (specs, CBO catalogs, audits) per profile. Read-only cross-view: a QA session can see Dev-produced specs, but writes always land under the active profile. |

### Tier-based readonly enforcement (Strict policy)

`SAP_TIER` is an enum: `DEV` | `QA` | `PRD`. Non-canonical tiers (Sandbox, Staging, Pre-Prod, Training) map to the safer equivalent (e.g. Staging → PRD).

| Tool family | DEV | QA | PRD |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Create*` / `Update*` / `Delete*` (DDIC, ABAP, CDS, BO, SB, MDE, Screen, GUI, Package) | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
| `CreateTransport` | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
| `RunUnitTest` | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ |
| `RuntimeRunProgramWithProfiling` / `RuntimeRunClassWithProfiling` | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
| `Get*` / `Read*` / `Search*` / `RuntimeAnalyze*` / `RuntimeList*` / `ValidateServiceBinding` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

Two-layer defense:
- **Layer 1 — PreToolUse hook** (`scripts/hooks/tier-readonly-guard.mjs`) installed via `scripts/install-hooks.mjs`. Fires before the tool request is sent; emits a clear deny reason the LLM can explain to the user.

Even if the user disables hooks or skips the plugin install, the server rejects mutation tools on QA/PRD with `ERR_READONLY_TIER`. `ReloadProfile` is always allowed so users can switch back to Dev without an escape hatch debate.

### OS keychain for passwords (`@napi-rs/keyring`)

Profiles store `SAP_PASSWORD=keychain:sc4sap/<alias>/<user>` — a reference, not the secret. The real value lives in the OS credential store:

| OS | Backend |
|---|---|
| Windows | Credential Manager |
| macOS | Keychain |
| Linux | libsecret (GNOME Keyring / KWallet) |

Existing plaintext `.sc4sap/sap.env` files are migrated into the keychain on first upgrade.

All via `/sc4sap:sap-option`:

- **Switch** — interactive picker (native `AskUserQuestion` UI) with per-profile preview panel showing connection details + the tools-allowed matrix. ### Migration from legacy single-profile `sap.env`

Existing users upgrading to the multi-profile release see a SessionStart banner (`scripts/legacy-migration-banner.mjs`) the first time they start Claude Code in a project with `.sc4sap/sap.env` but no `active-profile.txt`. The banner points them to `/sc4sap:sap-option` which drives a two-question migration wizard (alias, tier). The legacy file is renamed to `sap.env.legacy` for rollback; no data is deleted.

```

```

## Context Loading Architecture (v0.5.2+)

sc4sap's rule corpus is large — 25+ `common/*.md` + 14 `configs/{MODULE}/*.md` + 30+ industry/country files. Loading every file on every agent dispatch wastes tokens and dilutes model attention. The **4-tier context loading model** (defined in [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](../common/context-loading-protocol.md)) separates "always-load safety rails" from "role-specific baseline" from "condition-triggered" from "per-task kit".

| Tier | When loaded | Files |
|------|-------------|-------|
| **Tier 1 — Global Mandatory** | Every agent, every skill, every session start | `data-extraction-policy.md`, `sap-version-reference.md`, `naming-conventions.md` |
| **Tier 2 — Role-Mandatory** | Agent's role group fixed set, session start | varies by role group (see below) |
| **Tier 3 — Triggered Reads** | When a condition matches the current task | ALV → `alv-rules.md` · Procedural → `clean-code-procedural.md` + `ok-code-pattern.md` · `CALL SCREEN` → `ok-code-pattern.md` · ECC → `ecc-ddic-fallback.md` · industry/country set → corresponding file · etc. |
| **Tier 4 — Per-Task Kit** | Declared by the dispatching skill/phase/bucket | per wave in `phase4-parallel.md`, per §1-§12 in `phase6-review.md` |

### Tier 2 role groups

| Role group | Agents | Tier 2 adds |
|------------|--------|-------------|
| **Code Writer** | `sap-executor`, `sap-qa-tester`, `sap-debugger` | `clean-code.md`, `abap-release-reference.md`, `transport-client-rule.md`, `include-structure.md` (+ paradigm file) |
| **Reviewer** | `sap-code-reviewer`, `sap-critic` | `clean-code.md`, `abap-release-reference.md`, `include-structure.md` (per-bucket narrowing in Phase 6) |
| **Planner / Architect** | `sap-planner`, `sap-architect` | `include-structure.md`, `active-modules.md`, `customization-lookup.md`, `field-typing-rule.md` |
| **Analyst / Writer** | `sap-analyst`, `sap-writer` | `active-modules.md` |
| **Doc Specialist** | `sap-doc-specialist` | *(none — task-driven only)* |
| **Module Consultant** | 14 module consultants (SD, MM, FI, CO, PP, PS, PM, QM, TR, HCM, WM, TM, BW, Ariba) | `spro-lookup.md`, `customization-lookup.md`, `active-modules.md`, `configs/{MODULE}/*.md` (on demand — only the file the question needs) |
| **Basis Consultant** | `sap-bc-consultant` | `transport-client-rule.md`, `configs/common/*.md` |

### Enforcement

Every `agents/*.md` file declares its role group in a `<Mandatory_Baseline>` block at the top of `<Agent_Prompt>`. The agent loads Tier 1 + Tier 2 at session start before any MCP call. Skill prompts declare only Tier 4 (per-task) additions; Tier 1+2 are assumed. On a MAJOR blocker the agent returns `BLOCKED — context kit insufficient: <list>` so the skill can provide an updated kit.

### Measured effects

- Per-dispatch tokens: −40 to −60% vs pre-v0.5.0 implicit load-all pattern.
- Opus usage share in `/sc4sap:create-program`: −50% (routing matrix in `model-routing-rule.md`).
- Reviewer MAJOR-finding detection: improved — each of §1-§12 runs with only its relevant rule in context instead of skimming 12 rule files at once.

## Response Prefix Convention (v0.5.2+)

Every `/sc4sap:*` skill-triggered response begins with a one-line prefix so the user can see at a glance which model is running the work and which sub-agents were dispatched:

```
[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]
```

Examples:

```
[Model: Opus]
— pure main-thread response, no sub-agent dispatches

[Model: Opus · Dispatched: Sonnet×2]
— main thread + two parallel Sonnet executors (Wave 2 G4-prep text bulk)

[Model: Opus · Dispatched: Opus×1 (planner)]
— Phase 2 planner dispatch

[Model: Opus · Dispatched: Sonnet×3 (B3a executor range α/β/γ)]
— Multi-Executor Split per multi-executor-split.md Strategy A
```

The convention is enforced by a `<Response_Prefix>` block in every `/sc4sap:*` SKILL.md pointing to [`common/model-routing-rule.md`](../common/model-routing-rule.md) § *Response Prefix Convention*. The prefix applies only to skill-triggered turns and unrelated-pivot user messages drop the prefix on the turn they arrive.

471	## 🔒 Data Extraction Blocklist
472	
473	Defense-in-depth layer preventing row data from sensitive tables (PII, credentials, payroll, banking, transactional finance) via `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`.
474	
475	**Four enforcement layers**: L1 agent instructions · L2 global directive in `CLAUDE.md` · L3 Claude Code `PreToolUse` hook · L4 MCP server env-gated guard.

481	| minimal | Banking/Payment, Master-data PII, Addresses, Auth/Security, HR/Payroll, Tax/Govt IDs, Pricing/Conditions, custom `Z*` PII patterns |
482	| standard | + Protected Business Data (VBAK/BKPF/ACDOCA/VBRK/EKKO/CDHDR/STXH + CDS) |
483	| strict | + Audit/Security logs, Communication/Workflow |

505	export SC4SAP_POLICY_PROFILE=strict
506	export SC4SAP_BLOCKLIST_PATH=/path/to/sc4sap/exceptions/table_exception.md
507	export SC4SAP_ALLOW_TABLE=TAB1,TAB2  # session emergency exemption (logged)
508	```
509

512	## 🚫 `acknowledge_risk` — HARD RULE
513	
514	`GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` accept `acknowledge_risk: true` to bypass the ask-tier gate. **It is an audit boundary, not a convenience flag.**
515	
516	1. **Never set `acknowledge_risk: true` on a first call** — let the hook/server gate it
517	2. **On an `ask` response**, STOP — surface the refusal to the user
518	3. **Ask an explicit yes/no question** naming the tables and scope
519	4. **Only retry with `acknowledge_risk: true`** after an explicit affirmative keyword: `yes` / `y` / `승인` / `authorize` / `approve` / `proceed` / `confirmed`
520	5. **Ambiguous imperatives are NOT authorization** — `"pull it"`, `"try it"`, `"뽑아봐"`, `"my mistake"`, silence
521	6. **Per-call, per-table, per-session** — authorization does not carry over
522	
523	Full protocol: `common/data-extraction-policy.md`.
524	
525	### ⚠️ "Always allow" pitfall
526	When a `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` permission prompt appears, choose **"Allow once"**, never **"Always allow"**. Claude Code appends the tool ID to `permissions.allow` on "Always allow", permanently disabling the safeguard. Recovery: re-run any parent skill — `trust-session` Step 2 scans and strips `GetTableContents`/`GetSqlQuery` entries on every invocation.

533	|---|---|---|
534	| `odata` (default) | HTTPS OData v2 `ZMCP_ADT_SRV` | Works on hardened Gateway installs; routes through standard Gateway auth (S_SERVICE). [docs/odata-backend.md](odata-backend.md) |
535	| `soap` | HTTPS `/sap/bc/soap/rfc` | Classic path when `/sap/bc/soap/rfc` ICF node is active (increasingly disabled in production) |
536	
537	`native`, `gateway` and `zrfc` were removed in MCP 4.10.0 — the MCP server refuses to start with them. Switch to `odata` or `soap`.
538

- **Syntax Checker** — Auto-runs semantic analysis on ABAP errors
- **🔒 Data Extraction Blocklist** — `PreToolUse` hook blocks row extraction from sensitive SAP tables

## 🔒 Data Extraction Blocklist

Defense-in-depth layer preventing row data from sensitive tables (PII, credentials, payroll, banking, transactional finance) via `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`.

**Four enforcement layers**: L1 agent instructions · L2 global directive in `CLAUDE.md` · L3 Claude Code `PreToolUse` hook · L4 MCP server env-gated guard.

**Blocklist source**: `exceptions/table_exception.md` is the index; actual lists live in 11 per-section files under `exceptions/`.

| Tier | Coverage |
|------|----------|
| minimal | Banking/Payment, Master-data PII, Addresses, Auth/Security, HR/Payroll, Tax/Govt IDs, Pricing/Conditions, custom `Z*` PII patterns |
| standard | + Protected Business Data (VBAK/BKPF/ACDOCA/VBRK/EKKO/CDHDR/STXH + CDS) |
| strict | + Audit/Security logs, Communication/Workflow |

**Actions**: `deny` (blocked) vs `warn` (proceeds with warning block). If any table in a call is `deny` → whole call blocked.

**Profiles** (picked during `/sc4sap:setup`): `strict` / `standard` / `minimal` / `custom`. Site-specific additions via `.sc4sap/blocklist-extend.txt`.

**Install** (automated by `/sc4sap:setup`; manual):
```bash
node scripts/install-hooks.mjs            # user-level
node scripts/install-hooks.mjs --project  # project-level
```

**Verify**:
```bash
echo '{"tool_name":"mcp__abap__GetTableContents","tool_input":{"table":"BNKA"}}' \
  | node scripts/hooks/block-forbidden-tables.mjs
# Expected: JSON with "permissionDecision":"deny"
```

**L4 server-side enforcement** (stops any client — including external scripts):
```bash
export SC4SAP_POLICY=on
export SC4SAP_POLICY_PROFILE=strict
export SC4SAP_BLOCKLIST_PATH=/path/to/sc4sap/exceptions/table_exception.md
export SC4SAP_ALLOW_TABLE=TAB1,TAB2  # session emergency exemption (logged)
```

Schema/DDIC metadata (`GetTable`, `GetStructure`, `GetView`, `GetDataElement`, `GetDomain`) and existence checks remain allowed.

## 🚫 `acknowledge_risk` — HARD RULE

`GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` accept `acknowledge_risk: true` to bypass the ask-tier gate. **It is an audit boundary, not a convenience flag.**

1. **Never set `acknowledge_risk: true` on a first call** — let the hook/server gate it
2. **On an `ask` response**, STOP — surface the refusal to the user
3. **Ask an explicit yes/no question** naming the tables and scope
4. **Only retry with `acknowledge_risk: true`** after an explicit affirmative keyword: `yes` / `y` / `승인` / `authorize` / `approve` / `proceed` / `confirmed`
5. **Ambiguous imperatives are NOT authorization** — `"pull it"`, `"try it"`, `"뽑아봐"`, `"my mistake"`, silence
6. **Per-call, per-table, per-session** — authorization does not carry over

Full protocol: `common/data-extraction-policy.md`.

### ⚠️ "Always allow" pitfall
When a `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` permission prompt appears, choose **"Allow once"**, never **"Always allow"**. Claude Code appends the tool ID to `permissions.allow` on "Always allow", permanently disabling the safeguard. Recovery: re-run any parent skill — `trust-session` Step 2 scans and strips `GetTableContents`/`GetSqlQuery` entries on every invocation.

## 🔀 RFC Backend Selection

Screen / GUI Status / Text Element operations dispatch through RFC-enabled FMs on SAP. 2 transport backends:

| `SAP_RFC_BACKEND` | How | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `odata` (default) | HTTPS OData v2 `ZMCP_ADT_SRV` | Works on hardened Gateway installs; routes through standard Gateway auth (S_SERVICE). [docs/odata-backend.md](odata-backend.md) |
| `soap` | HTTPS `/sap/bc/soap/rfc` | Classic path when `/sap/bc/soap/rfc` ICF node is active (increasingly disabled in production) |

`native`, `gateway` and `zrfc` were removed in MCP 4.10.0 — the MCP server refuses to start with them. Switch to `odata` or `soap`.

Switch any time via `/sc4sap:sap-option`, reconnect MCP, verify with `/sc4sap:sap-doctor`.

### If the web port cannot be opened: RFC (NCo)

Instead of the web port, sc4sap can connect through the **RFC port (33 + instance number)** with the SAP .NET Connector (NCo) on the developer PC.

| Item | Web port | NCo |
|---|---|---|
| Port | web 80NN / 443NN | RFC 33NN |
| ICF nodes (B2) | needed | not needed |
| Gateway service registration (B5) | needed | not needed |
| `S_SERVICE` | needed | not needed |
| `S_ADT_RES` | needed | **also needed** (ADT checks it over RFC too) |
| `S_RFC` | ADT + Z function modules | same + `SADT_REST` (ADT over RFC) |
| Z function install and transport | install on DEV → transport to QA | same |
| Developer PC | any | Windows with NCo installed |

> **Every user installs NCo on their own PC.** NCo (SAP Connector for Microsoft .NET 3.1) is licensed SAP software, so sc4sap cannot ship it. Download it from the SAP Support Portal (Software Downloads) with an S-user that may download software. Without one, ask your Basis team for the installer. Some PCs already have it with SAP GUI.

| Other limits | Details |
|---|---|
| Windows only | Not on Mac or Linux; those PCs use the web port. |
| Direct server only | Application server + instance number only. No message server (logon groups), SAProuter or SNC. |
| Encryption | Without SNC the RFC traffic is not encrypted. Use it inside the company network only, and confirm with Basis. |
| Z function version | `ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH` needs the NCo function (`FM_PROXY`). Current sources include it. |
| Same authorizations | `S_ADT_RES` and the read / development authorizations stay the same. Only ICF, Gateway and `S_SERVICE` drop out. |

content.content:
== evidence-receipt
# Evidence Receipt — Done Criteria decided by a script, not by an agent

Companion of [`verification-evidence.md`](verification-evidence.md) (Rule 2). There, the agent writes the Evidence block from the tool results it saw. A receipt takes that job away from the agent: the verdict of each check comes from the MCP responses themselv

Scope today: `create-program` Phase 8. Same cost in `standard` and `eco` — no extra agent; at most one extra `GetInactiveObjects` call.

== team-consultation-protocol
# Team Consultation Protocol

Shared protocol for sc4sap multi-specialist agent teams. Loaded as Tier 3 (triggered) when an agent spawn indicates `teamMode=true`. Full architecture: [`../docs/team-consultation-architecture.md`](../docs/team-consultation-architecture.md).

## Transport — return-based (members return, lead persists)

== intent-router
# Intent Router — knowledge vs lookup vs action

Shared by `/sc4sap:assist` and `/sc4sap:ask-consultant` (and the web front end, which has no slash commands). One user sentence is classified once, then handed to the skill that owns it. Neither skill asks the user to retype the request in the other skill.

## 1. Classes

== adobe-forms-verification
# Adobe forms — verification (metrics, gates, fixtures)

Shared by `adobe-preview`, `adobe-from-pdf` and `smartform-to-adobe`, and by the verifier who judges them.
Accuracy is a set of numbers measured against SAP's own print. A "pass" without the numbers is not a pass.

## 1. Ground truth
== offline-mode
# Offline Mode (no SAP connection)

Some consultants cannot connect sc4sap to the customer's SAP system. An **offline profile** lets them still use the workflows that do not need the system: design documents, consultant answers, project and role planning. This file is the single rule every skill

## How a profile is offline

== skill-router
# Skill Router — plain chat → the right sc4sap skill

Most users do not type `/sc4sap:<skill>`; they describe what they want in plain chat. The main thread decides once per request whether an sc4sap skill owns it and then either runs that skill or proposes it in one line. The digest below is injected at session s

Related: [`intent-router.md`](intent-router.md) splits `knowledge` / `lookup` / `action` between `ask-consultant` and `assist` once one of them runs. [`offline-mode.md`](offline-mode.md) decides which skills can run without a connection.

Read-only — no writes, no row extraction. A question about concrete documents ("which POs are open?") is handed to \`/sc4sap:assist\` in the same turn.

### \`/sc4sap:compare-programs\`
Compares 2–5 programs that run the same business scenario but split by module, country, persona or time horizon. Sonnet / Haiku extract the facts of each program; one Opus pass writes the comparison for a functional consultant: a verdict matrix with *Differences only*, field differences, the selection and output screens side by side, and a decision guide. ### \`/sc4sap:config-to-document\`
Documents one module's configuration as it is in the system (MM first; PP, SD, FI, LE and others through the same pipeline). ### \`/sc4sap:interface-mapping-spec\`
Writes an interface mapping specification as one editable HTML page in the classic template layout: cover, revision history, header, the Source → Target grid with conversion rules and MAPPING, an optional synchronous response block, the extraction condition and a field guide. The SAP side is read from DDIC (table, structure, view) or a function module signature; for a new interface it comes from a field list or the module consultant's proposal. The counterpart side is proposed; in-page checks flag gaps; versioned with an English companion.

### \`/sc4sap:module-to-process\`

## 일반 채팅 라우팅

대부분의 사용자는 슬래시 명령을 입력하는 대신 원하는 것을 말로 설명해요. [`common/skill-router.md`](../common/skill-router.md)의 요약이 세션 시작 때 주입돼요.

- **바로 실행**: 방법 / 이유 / 커스터마이징 질문 → `ask-consultant`. 구체적인 전표(미결 PO, 출고 전기, 릴리스, 보류, 역분개) → `assist` (쓰기 전에 항상 확인해요). 실행 
- **한 줄로 제안하고, 승인하면 실행**: 산출물 및 쓰기 스킬 (create-program, program-to-spec, config-to-document, uat-scenarios, …).
- **라우팅하지 않음**: 사용자가 직접 입력한 슬래시 명령, 이미 실행 중인 스킬, 플러그인 자체에 대한 질문.

[`common/intent-router.md`](../common/intent-router.md)는 한 문장을 지식(`ask-consultant`), 조회 또는 액션(`assist`)으로 나눠요. 사용자가 다시 입력할 필요는 없어요.
